newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 93 OF APRIL 8, 1997.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 93 OF APRIL 8, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)
COMMISSION DECISION of 19 March 1997 on import licences in respect of beef and veal products originating in Botswana, Kenya, Madagascar, Swaziland, Zimbabwe and Namibia (97/233/EC)
COMMISSION DECISION of 3 March 1997 drawing up lists of third countries from which the Member States authorize imports of sheep and goats (Text with EEA relevance) (97/232/EC)

COMMISSION DECISION of 3 March 1997 amending Decision 93/198/EEC laying down a model for the animal health conditions and veterinary certification for the importation of domestic ovine and caprine animals from third countries (Text with EEA relevance) (97/231/EC)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 612/97 of 7 April 1997 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 611/97 of 7 April 1997 fixing, for March 1997, the specific agricultural conversion rate for the amount of the reimbursement of storage costs in the sugar sector
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 610/97 of 7 April 1997 amending Regulation (EC) No 2190/96 as regards certain detailed rules for implementing the arrangements for export refunds on fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 609/97 of 7 April 1997 amending Regulation (EEC) No 3201/90 laying down detailed rules for the description and presentation of wines and grape musts
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 608/97 of 7 April 1997 on the supply of vegetable oil as food aid
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 607/97 of 7 April 1997 on the supply of cereals as food aid END OF DOCUMENT.
